reasons: The validated decode graph supports batch size 1 because each request needs its own absolute RoPE position.
Dynamic set_subtensor cache writes do not lower through the pinned MLX linker.
The correct fallback uses a full-cache where update, which is O(cache capacity) per layer and token.
A scheduler would add request compaction, per-row masks, and cache lifecycle logic before the graph can batch requests correctly.
outcome: Keep the notebook runtime deterministic and batch-1. Treat continuous batching as future backend work rather than feature theater.
